recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Mountain resort and ski area operator, with lift tickets, ski school, rentals, retail, dining, lodging, summer activities and golf

venue_service_capacity.value: Large network of owned destination, regional and local ski resorts, with lifts, terrain, many dining outlets and lodging properties

pass_membership_mix.value: Epic Pass season passes are central and sold before the season, with a large pass-holder base alongside lift tickets and the My Epic Gear membership
